name: OneTimeSecret
description: Containerized OneTimeSecret with customization, and without paid/account features. Just simple, secure password sharing. Keep sensitive info (passwords) out of your email & chat logs. Requires Redis container with a password set on it! See support thread for more information.

variables.name: OTS_DOMAIN
variables.description: Domain/host for generated links, either IP:7134 or sub.domain.com

variables.name: OTS_MASTER_KEY
variables.description: Please change to a randomly generated value for encryption.

variables.name: OTS_IMAGE_FAV_ICON
variables.description: Optional link to a favicon.ico file.

variables.name: OTS_IMAGE_LOGO
variables.description: Optional link to a logo file.

variables.name: OTS_COLOR
variables.description: Change the color theme of the web interface.

variables.name: OTS_SSL
variables.description: Changes how URLs are generated, with HTTPS or without (set to true for use behind reverse proxy!)
